fusions.name: Anchor Lines
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile web ahead of you for 5 seconds that draws nearby enemies inward. It deals 9 damage to each one it catches and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds; your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Wrapped and Drained
fusions.desc: A biting finish that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Tripwire
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to string a tripwire at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 16 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Felt Through the Silk
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying any of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
